description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for a Spring Boot application named 'notesbackend'. It provides basic endpoints including a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints such as welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info for the notesbackend application.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the Spring Boot application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Constructs a URL to Swagger UI based on the incoming request headers and redirects the client to the API documentation page.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' string indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns a string with information about the application.
